'''2023 European Championship Marvin Tegeler LS anakin saga''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Marvin Tegeler]] at [[2023 European Championship]] (Day 1).

== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Marvin Tegeler]]
* '''Event:''' [[2023 European Championship]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
* '''Format:''' [[Open]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|The Force Is Strong In My Family|V17-L-theforceisstronginmyfamily.gif}}
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:23Euro Tegeler LS Anakin Saga.txt |Download]]
